title: Software Factory social cutdown
request: Use four scenes covering the complete 12-second, 360-frame timeline: 0–2 seconds hook, 2–6 seconds real Factory Floor proof, 6–9 seconds real converter app proof, 9–12 seconds Kujo bumper. Hook copy: "Your idea. A tested app." Frame this as the supported local software workflow, not a guarantee for any idea. Use the supplied factory-floor-portrait and converter-app-portrait screenshots as authentic product evidence. Keep real UI details intact; never draw fake controls, statuses, or results. A modest crop or punch-in may guide attention, but preserve enough context to identify the app. The Factory Floor beat may use the short product claim "Reviewed contracts. Frozen tests." as its main headline; do not add captions, lower thirds, scene labels, or running header labels. The converter beat should let the real app speak for itself. End with the official kujo-logo K mark, Kujo in departure-mono, the CTA, and kujolang.ai. Use a monochrome palette, restrained movement, clean cuts, and generous reading time. Silence is intentional: no narration, music, or sound effects. Do not claim elapsed time, universal app support, unattended publication, or approval of unreviewed work. All claims must map to the supplied facts. Recompose for a 9:16 portrait frame; do not shrink the landscape layout. Use focused screenshot crops with enough surrounding UI to preserve their meaning. Keep essential copy away from the extreme top and bottom; no platform-specific safe-area guarantees.

facts.text: A reviewed JSON software pack defines requirements and tests without changing the controller.
Each run freezes its pack; verification and release bind to its hash. Construction workers cannot edit the tests.
Independent review and repeated acceptance checks gate a local candidate release.
Packs support local Node HTTP APIs, optional SQLite, and static browser interfaces.
The recorded converter mission completed with an approved local candidate; the qualification record identifies its source and pack hashes.

cta: Build your next factory with Kujo
